propositions: A removal record targeting a managed link with no peer confirmation should be declined without writing an UNLINK event, keeping the link net-active locally, and returning False from _inbound_unlink_one
A removal record targeting a confirmed peer link should still converge, removing exactly the named relation via rebar.unlink with relation scope preserved
A local link whose outbound ADD is deduped by an inbound same-vendor-type remote link must not be removed by an inbound removal record due to vendor type collision
Reopening the same declined removal record on a later pass should idempotently decline again without writing any mutations
A link whose only confirmation record has source='backfill' should be removed rather than declined to prevent false rejections in the first post-upgrade pass
An unopenable confirmation store should disable the check entirely and restore pre-story behavior, preserving fail-open safety semantics
